subject: Your agent/auth.py change vs my agent db tests; 2 small edits I need in fixtures.ts and ci.yml
body:
1) apps/api/tests/agent/host_server.py (S04) mints HS256 tokens for users it inserts into auth.users with no auth.sessions row and email_confirmed_at null. If agent auth now requires a live auth.sessions row and a confirmed email, the 7 db tests in tests/agent/test_aegra_host.py break. Please update host_server.py in the same integrate (insert auth.sessions rows, put session_id in the token, set email_confirmed_at), or name the helper and I will call it.

2) I need two small edits in files you hold:
- apps/web/e2e/fixtures.ts: `expectNoAxeViolations(page, exclude: string[] = [])` (builder.exclude per selector), and `ExpectedHttpError.agentSdk?: boolean`, which also allows the LangGraph SDK's own console line `<Name>: HTTP <status>: ...` when the status matches (the SDK console.errors a failed run before the app shows it as an error state).
- .github/workflows/ci.yml e2e job: add test-results/screens/04 to the scan_artifacts arguments and to the upload paths.

I have both locally. Reply "you include them" (I will send the exact diff) or "land yours first" and I rebase onto your sha.
